drug_name: Glandula Suprarenalis / Hepar / Histaminum Hydrochloricum / Alternaria / Aspergillus Niger / Candida Albicans / Candida Parapsilosis / Dust / Mucor Racemosus / Torula Cerevisiae / House Dust Mite / Adrenocorticotrophin / Rhizopus Nigricans
what_its_for: This homeopathic combination product is used to help support your body's natural response to allergies, sensitivities to molds (such as Alternaria, Aspergillus, Candida, Mucor, Rhizopus, and Torula), dust, and house dust mites. It may also help support adrenal and liver function. It is commonly used to help reduce symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, skin reactions, or general fatigue that may be linked to environmental allergies or sensitivities.
how_to_take: This product is usually available as oral drops, tablets, or sublingual (under-the-tongue) drops. Place the recommended dose under your tongue or dissolve tablets in your mouth and let them absorb slowly. Do not swallow immediately — hold the drops or tablet under your tongue for about 30 to 60 seconds before swallowing. Take on a clean mouth, ideally at least 15 to 30 minutes before or after eating, drinking, or brushing your teeth. Do not handle tablets with unwashed hands.
dosing: Typical adult dosing is 10 drops or 1 tablet taken 3 times daily, or as directed by your healthcare provider. For acute symptoms, some products allow dosing every 15 minutes for up to 2 hours, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose on the label. Always follow the specific directions on your product label or your doctor's instructions, as formulations can vary.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double up doses to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C). Keep away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Do not store in the bathroom. Keep the cap tightly closed when not in use. Keep this and all medications out of the reach of children. Do not use after the expiration date printed on the package.
what_to_avoid: Avoid taking this product with strongly flavored foods, mint, coffee, or camphor-containing products right before or after your dose, as these may interfere with how homeopathic remedies work. Avoid touching the tablet directly with your hands if possible — use the cap to dispense. Do not use if the seal is broken or the product looks unusual. Talk to your doctor before combining this with other allergy medications, steroids, or immunotherapy treatments.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience any signs of a serious allergic reaction, including hives, swelling of the face or throat, difficulty breathing, or chest tightness. Also contact your doctor if your symptoms get significantly worse, if you develop new or unusual symptoms, if you have no improvement after several weeks of use, or if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to give this product to a child. Let your doctor know about all other medications and supplements you are taking.
when_it_works: Homeopathic products like this one work gradually. Some people may notice mild improvement in allergy-related symptoms within the first few days to a couple of weeks of consistent use. Full benefit is often seen after several weeks of regular use. Results can vary from person to person. This product is not a fast-acting rescue medication for sudden or severe allergy attacks.
special_populations: Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this product. Use in children should only be done under the guidance of a healthcare provider, as dosing may need to be adjusted. People with known allergies to bovine (cow-derived) ingredients should speak with their doctor before use, as this product contains bovine adrenal and liver components. Elderly patients and those with immune system conditions or chronic illnesses should also consult a healthcare provider before starting this product.
